messages.subject: Firm notice - month-end time recording due Friday
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Reminder that August time recording must be entered and submitted by 5pm this Friday for month-end billing. Please make sure all WIP is up to date and any disbursements are coded to the correct matter. Practice management will lock the period over the weekend.

Thanks,
Sarah
